name: Contract Lifecycle – Renewal Detection, Risk Analysis & Approvals

parameters.content:
## Contract Lifecycle Workflow

Ingests a contract, detects upcoming renewals, runs risk analysis, evaluates dynamic approval requirements, and returns a full lifecycle decision with audit trail.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - Contract Intake – Receives new or updated contract data via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Normalize – Validates required fields and normalizes contract metadata.
3. Code - Renewal Detection – Calculates days-to-expiry and flags contracts needing renewal action.
4. Wait - Pre Risk – Short pause before risk analysis.
5. HTTP Request - Risk Analysis Engine – Sends contract details to an external risk scoring service.
6. Code - Process Risk Score – Interprets risk score and maps it to risk tier (low / medium / high).
7. Wait - Pre Policy – Pause before policy evaluation.
8. Code - Evaluate Approval Policy – Determines required approval levels based on value, risk and renewal status.
9. Wait - Pre Approval – Pause before approval routing.
10. HTTP Request - Approval System – Submits the contract for the required multi-level approvals.
11. Code - Process Approval Result – Records approval decision and final lifecycle status.
12. Code - Build Lifecycle Report – Creates a complete report including renewal, risk and approval outcomes.
13. Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the final response payload for the caller.
14. Respond to Webhook – Returns the contract lifecycle decision and audit trail.

## 1. Intake & Renewal Detection

Webhook - Contract Intake – Receives new or updated contract data via POST.
Code - Validate & Normalize – Validates required fields and normalizes contract metadata.
Code - Renewal Detection – Calculates days-to-expiry and flags contracts needing renewal action.

## 2. Risk Analysis & Policy

Wait - Pre Risk – Short pause before risk analysis.
HTTP Request - Risk Analysis Engine – Sends contract details to an external risk scoring service.
Code - Process Risk Score – Interprets risk score and maps it to risk tier (low / medium / high).
Wait - Pre Policy – Pause before policy evaluation.
Code - Evaluate Approval Policy – Determines required approval levels based on value, risk and renewal status.

## 3. Approval & Finish

Wait - Pre Approval – Pause before approval routing.
HTTP Request - Approval System – Submits the contract for the required multi-level approvals.
Code - Process Approval Result – Records approval decision and final lifecycle status.
Code - Build Lifecycle Report – Creates a complete report including renewal, risk and approval outcomes.
Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the final response payload for the caller.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the contract lifecycle decision and audit trail.
